scope: Prospective clarification for repair actions. Frozen pairing protocol remains archived.
eligibility: Full observed source IDs and decoded complete paragraphs match, unanimous pre-Gold asserted-arithmetic role receipt, replayable literal invalidation, READY dual-frontier carry and no-carry plans.
source_integrity_errors: Raise and block the attempt. Runtime failures after READY raise and preserve prior completed results.
boundary_filter: Before any repair output, filter observed blank-paragraph offsets through the native lexical markup-closure check and record rejected offsets.
same_checked_evidence: Every arm receives exactly the checked bad-equality packet. GenericRewind, RebaseCarry, FullRestart, SameEvidenceCompactBridge and independent Resampling also receive exactly the full verified carry packet.
NoCarry_ablation: RebaseNoCarry uses the same rebase cut and same checked bad-equality packet, deliberately omitting carry serialization.
cut_and_prefix_equivalence: Report GenericRewind and RebaseCarry cut equality and actual pre-decode prefix hashes. Identical conditions remain identical rather than being altered to manufacture a carry advantage.
native_reconstruction: Reuse frozen D1 prompt prefill then retained singleton teacher forcing. Materialize bridge with new singleton forwards.
arm_RNG: Checkpoint post-observation RNG state for the five repair arms. Modified prefixes can induce different distributions.
resampling_target: Maximum measured postcheckpoint elapsed seconds among the five repair arms, fixed before Gold.
resampling_stopping: Complete each native attempt to EOS or actual context boundary. Accumulate all paid attempt cost until a completed EOS replica crosses target, or the technical eight-attempt guard is reached.
resampling_selection: Plurality among completed EOS replicas using frozen D0 LastBox rational/surface fingerprints, earliest occurrence tie, all replicas saved. No Gold-based choice.
resampling_bracket: Expose completed-EOS plurality choices and cumulative paid work below and above target. Without both measured points, report unavailable matched-cost bracket.
cost: Record each arm replay, evidence injection, native decode and hot copy work. Add the same observed-prefix forward work once to each full-cost description. Original prefix wall stays null when unmeasured.
role_review_cost: Pre-Gold review receipts are supplied by the trusted review process. Their external review cost is distinct from executor preparation and model generation.
generation_quality: Natural EOS or loaded actual context capacity for all continuations. Proposal limits are separate from the final continuation.
outputs: folder/repair/REPAIR_STATUS.json plus every standalone arm and every resampling replica. A repeated attempt uses a separate folder.
